description: Start here to create a Studium lesson from sources the learner chose. Returns tell_learner, one sentence saying that writing the lesson takes a few minutes: tell it to the learner as it is, with your prepare_sources call, and go on without waiting for a reply. Then the authoring brief (markdown, French for a fr-* language, English otherwise), draft_schema (the JSON Schema of a LessonDraft) and a minimal valid example. mode: self_study (default) or teacher (says where the teacher route starts).
name: get_authoring_guide
